0022600147.text: The Utah Jazz (1-4, 1-3 at home) host the Portland Trail Blazers (3-0) for the Jazz's sixth game of the season, with Utah on a three-game losing streak, 5th in the Northwest and 3 games back, and 13th in the West. Portland is 3-0 with three straight wins, first in the Northwest and 2nd in the West, and Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Lauri Markkanen (wrist), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Portland is without Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series the Jazz lost 0-4, including a 124-114 loss in Portland on March 13, 2026.
